nodes.label: skin condition type
nodes.description: The specific type of skin condition (e.g., rosacea, sensitive skin) that the product is designed for.

nodes.label: ingredient sensitivity
nodes.description: Whether the product contains ingredients that are known to irritate sensitive or redness-prone skin.

nodes.label: product formulation
nodes.description: The type of formulation (e.g., gel, cream, serum) and its effectiveness for redness.

nodes.label: application method
nodes.description: How the product is applied and whether the method supports redness reduction.

nodes.label: targeted treatment
nodes.description: Whether the product is specifically formulated to target redness and irritation.

nodes.label: skin type compatibility
nodes.description: Whether the product is suitable for the user's specific skin type (e.g., sensitive, oily).

nodes.label: brand reputation
nodes.description: The reputation of the brand for producing effective and safe products for redness-prone skin.

nodes.label: price range
nodes.description: The cost of the product and whether it is considered affordable or premium.

nodes.label: user experience
nodes.description: The overall user experience, including ease of use and effectiveness as reported by users.
